result.title: Discussion: replace post-hoc compact-changelog with file-per-change tooling (evaluate changie for 2026)
result.author: isaacschepp
result.body_snippet:
## Summary

`compact-changelog.md` exists because agentic edits create duplicate `### Added` sections, self-cancelling Added/Removed pairs, and follow-up Fixed entries that should fold into the original Added. **File-per-change tools eliminate this class of problem at the source by writing each change to its own file**, then assembling at release time. The compact-changelog command is, at best, post-hoc cleanup of a problem that need not exist.

This is a Discussion, not a Bug or Enhancement — i

## Summary

`compact-changelog.md` exists because agentic edits create duplicate `### Added` sections, self-cancelling Added/Removed pairs, and follow-up Fixed entries that should fold into the original Added. **File-per-change tools eliminate this class of problem at the source by writing each change to its own file**, then assembling at release time. The compact-changelog command is, at best, post-hoc cleanup of a problem that need not exist.
